purpose: Workflow and instruction audit, not full source correctness or runtime verification
method: Documentation and policy review; source inventories, import graph and sampled critical paths. Skill scripts were inspected for routing and workflow clauses, not audited line by line. Read manifests describe file access and reviewed scope, not runtime activation.

coverage-method: Coverage method: every text file in the assigned skill/config trees was read in full by the audit scanner. Manual/model reading focused on all entrypoints and discovered authority, mandatory gate, routing, version, model, review, publishing and approval clauses. Scripts were inspected structurally and specific mutations/gates were read; this is not a line-by-line correctness/security review of all generated/vendor JS or every example. The coverage manifest records content access, not proof of runtime activation or manual review of every line. Two shadcn PNG icons are inventory-only. Dynamic installed agent-browser core/electron/dogfood skill content and Impeccable engine-emitted instructions were not executed or reviewed; external upstream URLs and external Psychopomp checkout source are beyond this read-only assigned tree scope. No repo files changed.

history.scope: Selected recent relevant primary turns, not complete transcripts
